name: agent-cubes
description: A live view of your agents' work beside the Claude Code chat, as glass cubes or as a circuit board: a step each, progress, agents, a live feed, stuck detection, context and cost, eight skins, five solder masks

defaultSkin.title: Default skin
defaultSkin.description: The skin used until you pick another one in the panel. A pick in the panel wins.

defaultView.title: Default view
defaultView.description: How the task is drawn until you pick a view in the panel: cubes on a pedestal, or chips on a circuit board. A pick in the panel wins.

budgetUsd.title: Cost budget per task (USD)
budgetUsd.description: From 80 % the cost turns amber; above the budget a notice appears. 0 turns the budget off.

autoOpen.title: Open the panel automatically
autoOpen.description: Opens the Agent Cubes panel when each session starts. Off: only via /cubes.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Filling cubes, flying agents, mood lights and the flow in the pipe. Off: a calm still image, in exports too.

gaugeRow.title: Canister row
gaugeRow.description: A row of glass canisters for progress, context, budget and waiting above the overview. The figure tiles below show the same values.

stuckSilentMinutes.title: Stuck after silence (minutes)
stuckSilentMinutes.description: A cube counts as stuck when no tool call came for this many minutes (0.5 to 240).

stuckFailsInRow.title: Stuck after failures in a row
stuckFailsInRow.description: This many failed tool calls in a row mark a cube as stuck (1 to 50).

stuckSlowFactor.title: Stuck at x times the usual duration
stuckSlowFactor.description: A cube counts as stuck when it runs this much longer than a usual step (at least 8 minutes; 1.1 to 50).
